# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

Participation in ELTE Schedule Builder should be welcoming, useful, and safe
for students and contributors of every experience level, identity, background,
and ability.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful, patient, and specific.
- Critique ideas and changes, not people.
- Assume good intent; take correction gracefully.
- Protect student privacy — strip personal schedule data from reports.
- Respect maintainers' time, project scope, and documented decisions.
- Keep technical discussions understandable for student contributors.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, threats, discrimination, or personal attacks.
- Sexualized language or unwanted attention.
- Trolling, sustained disruption, or deliberately misleading reports.
- Publishing someone's private information without permission.
- Pressuring anyone to disclose security details publicly.
- Abusing project communication channels or infrastructure.

## Scope

Applies in issues, pull requests, reviews, and anywhere else used to represent
or coordinate this project.

## Reporting and enforcement

Report concerns privately to `w04m1@proton.me`, subject `ELTE Schedule Builder
conduct report`. Include links or screenshots; leave out unrelated personal
information.

The maintainer may edit or remove contributions, limit participation, or take
other proportionate action. Reports are handled as privately and fairly as
practical — no formal response-time guarantee.
